title: Strict majority verifier
statement: Given a Boolean-output verifier $M$ and functions $p,k$ from natural numbers to natural numbers, define a verifier on Boolean lists $x,r$ by dividing $r$ into consecutive blocks of length $p(|x|)$ and applying $M$ to $x$ and each of the first $k(|x|)$ blocks. It outputs true exactly when strictly more than half of these $k(|x|)$ runs return true.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ maps pairs of Boolean lists to Booleans
$p$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
$k$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
